title: Support for adding `PromptTemplate`s of Jinja2 template format
body:
Hi there!

Currently adding `PromptTemplate`s of  Jinja2 template format is not supported:

https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/blob/64261449b837c937f7152b1966b5ec1cf6b745de/libs/core/langchain_core/prompts/prompt.py#L136-L145

while it would be quite useful for the users employing Jinja2 as the template format. If there's no major limitation to it, I'd be happy to contribute a PR to add support.

linked_prs.title: feat(core): support for adding `PromptTemplate`s with formats other than `f-string`
linked_prs.body: Allow adding`PromptTemplate`s with formats other than `f-string`. Fixes #32151

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue relates to prompt templates, which are a key component of LLM-based agent systems. Adding support for Jinja2 template format in `PromptTemplate` aligns with prompt management, making it an agent issue.
